{{Term/Store|Deer Hunting||Series, BotW}} is a [[Mini-Game]] in {{BotW}}.<ref name="Dantz">{{Cite|About that {{Color BotW|Red|deer hunting}}... No time like the present, right? Go get started, and I'll call you once your {{Color BotW|Red|minute}} is up, OK?|Dantz|BotW}}</ref>

==Location and Rules==
Deer Hunting is operated by [[Dantz]] from [[Hateno Pasture]], which is located in [[Hateno Village]]. When [[Link]] first approaches [[Dantz]], he realizes that he is a traveler.<ref>{{Cite|Oh! Good day, stranger! Hrm? Are you some kinda wanderer?|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Since he looks capable of using a [[Bow]], Dantz asks Link if he would be willing to help him.<ref>{{Cite|You look handy with a bow. Mind helping a poor farmer out?|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> He explains that [[Retsam Forest]] has become overpopulated by [[Deer]], which is destructive to the environment.<ref>{{Cite|So what I need is for you to hunt some {{Color BotW|Red|deer}} out in {{Color BotW|Blue|Retsam Forest}}. They're overpopulated these days, and it's destroying the forest.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Therefore, he gives Link a one minute time limit to hunt as many of the Deer in the Forest as he can.<ref>{{Cite|That's why I was hoping you could hunt all the {{Color BotW|Red|deer}} you can...in {{Color BotW|Red|one minute}}.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref>

If Link accepts this task, Dantz asks if he can head out right away.<ref>{{Cite|Thank you! Can...can you go right away?|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Link can ask Dantz for hunting tips before starting the [[Mini-Game]]. Dantz suggests using a strong Bow that will take down a Deer in one shot..<ref>{{Cite|[Is there a trick to this?] A trick? Well, I guess it helps to have a strong bow to take 'em down with one shot.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> He also says that Link should use [[Stealth]] to sneak up on the Deer before attacking.<ref>{{Cite|And of course, you want to get close enough to the deer to line up your shot without them noticing you.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref>

When Link decides to start the Mini-Game, Dantz will remind him that he is counting on him.<ref>{{Cite|What a trooper! I'm counting on you!|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Link will then be transferred to Retsam Forest, where Dantz explains that he will call him once his minute is up.<ref name="Dantz"/> During this time, Link will have to hunt as many Mountain Bucks as he can. Should Link stray too far from the Retsam Forest, Dantz will end the Mini-Game and call him back.<ref>{{Cite|You've gone too far! Come back!|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Once the minute is up, Dantz will yell for Link to return.<ref>{{Cite|That's time! Come back, wanderer!|Dantz|BotW}}</ref>

Back at Hateno Pasture, Dantz will review how many Deer that Link hunted. If Link failed to get a single Deer, Dantz will refuse to give him a reward.<ref>{{Cite|Huh? You didn't even get ONE? Sorry, but no results, no reward.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> However, if Link hunted one to three Deer, Dantz offers his thanks and rewards him with a [[Green Rupee]].<ref>{{Cite|Thanks for doing your part! Here's a reward for you...|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Next, if Link killed four to six Deer, Dantz calls him vicious with his Bow and gifts him a [[Blue Rupee]].<ref>{{Cite|You're downright vicious with that bow, wanderer! Here's a reward for you...|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> When Link hunts between seven to nine Deer, Dantz is impressed by his initiative and gives him a [[Red Rupee]].<ref>{{Cite|I knew you were a go-getter, but this is more than I ever dreamed of! Here's a reward for you...|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Finally, if Link conquers all 10 Deer in Retsam Forest, Dantz tells him that it is possible to be too good at hunting and rewards Link with a [[Purple Rupee]].<ref>{{Cite|You got 10 deer?! Easy there, wanderer. I didn't think I'd be saying this, but there's such a thing as being TOO good a hunter. I won't skimp on it this time!|Dantz|BotW}}</ref>

After giving Link his reward, Dantz reiterates that they need to get the Deer population under control.<ref>{{Cite|The thing with these deer, though... We really have to get their numbers under control.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> Therefore, he asks Link if he would be willing to head into the Retsam Forest again.<ref>{{Cite|Hey, wanderer, can I ask you to go again?|Dantz|BotW}}</ref> If Link refuses, Dantz is disappointed and tells him to return if he changes his mind.<ref>{{Cite|Oh. Well, shucks. Let me know if you ever change your mind.|Dantz|BotW}}</ref>
